mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% over the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during tightening labor market periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals increased demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increased housing starts (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last month signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of decreased industrial production (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the last month, coupled with a CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase of less than 0.2%, it signals strong labor demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 & CPIAUCSL increase < 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor demand without inflation (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the last three months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, it signals increased consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% & UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increased consumer demand and tightening labor market (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the last three months signals increased supply and productivity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increased industrial production (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
